opportunities.name: Starcall funded rescue
opportunities.objective: Test whether Q contact and out-of-combat reset can fund repeated low-cost W casts.
opportunities.mechanic: Q grants Rejuvenation healing and movement; W health cost is reduced by 80-100% while Rejuvenation is active and transfers it to the ally. Warmog supplies an out-of-combat reset only after 2000 bonus health; Visage enhances Soraka own Q recovery. Moonstone and Redemption support ally rescue while the quest remains retained.
opportunities.requiredState: Confirm actual bonus-health threshold, eight seconds without damage for Warmog, and Q before W.
opportunities.failure: Burst or constant damage prevents the reset; missed Q spends health at full cost.
opportunities.test: Log W health cost with/without Rejuvenation and Warmog activation at actual observed bonus health.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Warmog is not in-combat regeneration and its threshold is not presumed satisfied.

opportunities.name: Equinox artillery escort
opportunities.objective: Use AP to threaten both Equinox hits while improving low-health Wish rescue.
opportunities.mechanic: E deals 0.4 AP magic damage on placement and again on its delayed root; Q slow helps hold the zone. R has 0.5 AP healing increased by half on allies below 40%. Cryptbloom can add a takedown heal and Mandate needs the E root, while Staff/Helia turn successful offensive contact into ally support.
opportunities.requiredState: Target stays in E for 1.5 seconds; Q and healing recipients are available.
opportunities.failure: Silence alone does not root; delaying healing to fish for damage loses allies.
opportunities.test: Measure E first hit, root/second hit, Mandate mark and subsequent Helia heal/Wish.
opportunities.rejectedAssumption: Silence is not the immobilization required for current Mandate.

ruledOut.idea: R scales with recipient missing-health continuously
ruledOut.reason: Wish documents a below-40% bonus, not an unrestricted continuous missing-health multiplier.

unknowns: Warmog threshold must include observed item-health conversion, not arbitrary bonus stacks. Helia and Rejuvenation transfer interaction needs logs.

testPlan: Required state: Confirm actual bonus-health threshold, eight seconds without damage for Warmog, and Q before W.
Log W health cost with/without Rejuvenation and Warmog activation at actual observed bonus health.

Run three trials at matched level, ranks, gold and target defenses. Repeat against a moving opponent with a fixed incoming damage pattern. Record damage packets, missed actions, resource cost and survival separately.
Keep souls, health/mana, form, item/rune stacks, transformations and game time finite and explicitly recorded. No free full ramp or infinite scaling.
failureConditions: Burst or constant damage prevents the reset; missed Q spends health at full cost.
The narrow damage gain does not repay lost access, survival, wave control or allied utility.
tradeoffs: Rejected assumption: Warmog is not in-combat regeneration and its threshold is not presumed satisfied.
Confidence: speculative. Source-compatible reasoning is not in-game validation or proof of novelty/optimality.
buyOrder: Candidate six slots: Celestial Opposition, Warmog's Armor, Spirit Visage, Moonstone Renewer, Redemption, Boots of Swiftness. Compare two-item checkpoints before the final six-slot test; this list is not a lane shopping order.
Keep role-appropriate starters, boots and support quest/vision obligations. If the full candidate assumes farmed income, compare it separately from support income.
coverageNotes: Only Cassiopeia Q/E and Sett W have numerical adapters. Even there, these other objectives and item/rune interactions may fall outside the model.
Proc inheritance, crit, pet hits and conditional helpers remain uncertain until observed. No completed mathematical maximum is claimed.

kitEvidence.formula:
Soraka calls down a star, dealing [85 / 120 / 155 / 190 / 225 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [30]% for [1.5] seconds. 

Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation, which restores [60 / 75 / 90 / 105 / 120 + (0.3) × AP] Health over [2.5] seconds and grants [(0.2 / 0.225 / 0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed decaying over the same duration.

Soraka restores [90 / 110 / 130 / 150 / 170 + (0.5) × AP] Health to another allied champion.

If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation, the Health cost will be reduced by [(0.8 / 0.85 / 0.9 / 0.95 / 1) × 100]%, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for @Spell.SorakaQ:HoTDuration@ seconds.

kitEvidence.formula: Soraka creates a starfield that deals [70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage to champions. The field lingers for [1.5] seconds, Silencing enemies inside. When the zone disappears, champions inside the zone are Rooted for [1 / 1.25 / 1.5 / 1.75 / 2] second(s) and take [70 / 95 / 120 / 145 / 170 + (0.4) × AP] magic damage.

Soraka calls down a star, dealing [85 / 120 / 155 / 190 / 225 + (0.35) × AP] magic damage and Slowing by [30]% for [1.5] seconds. 

Hitting an enemy champion grants Soraka Rejuvenation, which restores [60 / 75 / 90 / 105 / 120 + (0.3) × AP] Health over [2.5] seconds and grants [(0.2 / 0.225 / 0.25 / 0.275 / 0.3) × 100]% Move Speed decaying over the same duration.

Soraka calls upon divine powers, restoring [150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP] Health to all allied champions, regardless of distance. Healing is increased to [(150 / 250 / 350 + (0.5) × AP) × ((1 + 0.5))] on targets below 40% Health.

Soraka restores [90 / 110 / 130 / 150 / 170 + (0.5) × AP] Health to another allied champion.

If Soraka is affected by Rejuvenation, the Health cost will be reduced by [(0.8 / 0.85 / 0.9 / 0.95 / 1) × 100]%, and the target will gain Rejuvenation for @Spell.SorakaQ:HoTDuration@ seconds.
